item.title: How to upload multiple files in Node.js
item.description: Handling multiple file uploads simultaneously is crucial for Node.js applications with features like photo galleries, document management, or batch processing. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve built multi-file upload systems for enterprise document management platforms. The most effective solution is to use Multer’s array() or fields() methods to handle multiple files in a single request. This approach efficiently processes multiple files while maintaining validation and storage control.
